stem: 根据金融行动特别工作组(FATF)的方法,哪些情况需要金融机构(FI)考虑提交可疑活动报告？

options.A: 交易的受益人是政治公众人物.
options.B: 金融机构无法核实相关客户尽职调查文件.
options.C: FI确认付款人是贵金属或宝石的经销商.
options.D: 一笔交易涉及将资金从加密货币兑换为法定货币.

stem_en: According to the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) methodology, which situation would require a financial institution (FI) to consider filing a suspicious activity report?

options_en.A: A beneficiary of a transaction is a politically exposed person.
options_en.B: An FI is unable to verify the relevant customer due diligence documents.
options_en.C: An FI identifies that the payer is a dealer in precious metals or stones.
options_en.D: A transaction involves funds exchanged from crypto to fiat currencies.
